claim.quote: We present new νμ→νe, νμ→νμ, ν̄μ→ν̄e, and ν̄μ→ν̄μ oscillation measurements by the NOvA experiment, with a 50% increase in neutrino-mode beam exposure over the previously reported results.

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; the result was first made public as a preprint, so the earlier date is used (A9). Published as Phys. Rev. D 106, 032004 (2022).

key_value_text.quote: with $Δm^{2}_{32} = (2.41\pm0.07)\times 10^{-3}$ eV$^2$ and $\sin^2θ_{23} = 0.57^{+0.03}_{-0.04}$ ... excluded by $>3σ$ for the inverted mass ordering, and values around $δ_\text{CP} = 3π/2$ in the normal ordering which are disfavored at 2$σ$ confidence
key_value_text.value: Best fit: Δm²₃₂ = (2.41±0.07)×10⁻³ eV², sin²θ₂₃ = 0.57 +0.03/−0.04 (upper octant), best-fit point in the normal mass ordering; δ_CP near π/2 excluded by >3σ for the inverted ordering, values around 3π/2 disfavored at 2σ for the normal ordering

name: An Improved Measurement of Neutrino Oscillation Parameters by the NOvA Experiment

significance.locator: arXiv:2108.08219, abstract (no single significance/sigma reported for a parameter measurement)
significance.note: A multi-parameter oscillation measurement, not a single-significance discovery/observation; specific exclusions (e.g. delta_CP near pi/2 for inverted ordering) are quoted at different confidence levels in key_value_text.

summary.plain: NOvA's updated measurement of how muon neutrinos and antineutrinos change type over its 810-kilometre baseline, with a 50% increase in neutrino-mode data. The best-fit point is in the normal ordering of the neutrino masses and the upper octant of the θ23 mixing angle, and the data disfavor oscillation parameters that give a large asymmetry between neutrino and antineutrino appearance.
summary.technical: Joint νμ/ν̄μ disappearance and νe/ν̄e appearance fit within the three-flavor framework, with a 50% increase in neutrino-mode beam exposure over the previously reported results: best-fit point in the normal mass ordering and the upper octant of θ23, with Δm²₃₂ = (2.41±0.07)×10⁻³ eV² and sin²θ₂₃ = 0.57 +0.03/−0.04; values of δ_CP in the vicinity of π/2 are excluded by >3σ for the inverted mass ordering, and values around 3π/2 in the normal ordering are disfavored at 2σ.

title: An Improved Measurement of Neutrino Oscillation Parameters by the NOvA Experiment
why_it_matters: The abstract says the data disfavor combinations of oscillation parameters that give rise to a large asymmetry in the rates of νe and ν̄e appearance, including values of the CP-violating phase δ_CP near π/2 (excluded by >3σ for the inverted mass ordering) and values around 3π/2 in the normal ordering (disfavored at 2σ).
